2609.29233.title: Post-Training Leaves Behavioral Shadows on Unrelated Decisions
2609.29233.paper_summary: We find that language models can transfer capabilities through task-unrelated text. Post-training typically improves language models using task-specific data. Prior work on subliminal learning shows that information about these updates can pass through unrelated generations, but has largely focused on traits or preferences using extensive teacher outputs. We introduce Active Taskless Distillation (ATD), which achieves capability transfer using only a single word from the teacher per prompt. ATD probes the behavioral shadow of post-training by selecting prompts where the teacher and student's shared public ancestor is nearly indifferent between two ordinary words. A student initialized from this ancestor learns solely from the resulting prompt-word pairs, without target-task examples, teacher logits, or teacher parameters. 2609.29233.paper_summary_zh: 我們發現語言模型可以通過與任務無關的文本轉移能力。後訓練通常使用特定任務數據來改善語言模型。之前的潛意識學習研究顯示，關於這些更新的信息可以通過無關的生成傳遞，但主要集中在使用大量教師輸出來研究特徵或偏好。我們介紹了主動無任務蒸餾（Active Taskless Distillation, ATD），它僅使用每個提示中的一個單詞來實現能力轉移。ATD 通過選擇教師和學生的共享公共祖先在兩個普通單詞之間幾乎無差別的提示來探測後訓練的行為影子。從這個祖先初始化的學生僅從生成的提示-單詞對中學習，沒有目標任務示例、教師 logits 或教師參數。在主要的編碼實驗中，使用 Qwen2.5-1.5B，5,664 次實驗在 HumanEval+ 上產生了 5.34 個百分點的增益，超過了一個精確的干擾匹配控制，這破壞了提示-回應實驗，顯示在科學知識、常識推理和閱讀理解方面的轉移，涵蓋了額外的模型世代、大小和家族。功能分析顯示，學到的側面是可組合的，並且其強度與教師的更新強度相關。
